quote: Arabidopsis COP/ DET/FUS genes are negative regulators of photomorphogenesis.
note: Review statement in a News and Reviews piece, citing no study for this sentence; not this paper's own measurement. The paragraph defines photomorphogenesis as inhibition of stem elongation, activation of the shoot apical meristem and initiation of true leaves in light-grown seedlings.
